answer: Score trust as the landing probability of a short random walk seeded at the vetted honest core, not as a raw edge count. Probability mass flows from the seeds toward the ocean of honest nodes, but a sybil farm joins that world through only a thin bottleneck, so the trickle crossing the cut stays tiny however densely its personas vouch among themselves — internal edges just recirculate one drop, a closed sonnet with no new line. Each fake lands near-zero weight, stranding the farm on a frozen tundra outside the trusted mass.
